pitch:
The Deep Mine is a real-time maze-runner you play with one thumb. You grow a mycelium colony through a rock labyrinth, and every dig spends water. You push east under the ground toward the root of a green island, while heat, worms and mould make each metre deeper cost more. Every ending is a full payout, and each payout buys one concrete thing: a bigger tank, a longer dig, a tool that removes a threat outright, or a compass that points through rock. Each island you reach opens a new, harder world, chosen by hand. There are ten of them before the Promised Land. The maze is the star: a leg replays exactly, so a retry means you got better, and your last attempt stays drawn in the rock for you to beat.

LOOP IN ONE LINE: dig east on one tank -> the colony fruits and banks how far it reached -> buy one thing -> dig again, further.
coreLoop:
SYSTEM BUDGET. The whole game is five systems, and each one creates decisions:
(1) the dig and its water price (the heat staircase);
(2) the maze, with rewards off the route;
(3) two threats, each with one counter that fully solves it;
(4) the journey (legs, islands, taproots);
(5) the store (power, kit and knowledge).
Every wrapper (reach payout, mark, fossil, Daily Dig, New Journey) reuses these five and adds no rule of its own. There are no cards, no drafting and no per-run picks.

A DIG (1-2 s).
- Input: press any living strand, drag a direction and release. A tap on the colony digs straight down from the strand you tapped.
- Result: the colony grows 2-7 steps (3 segments of 25.5 units each) through open ground, dodging up to +/-80 degrees around rock, but only from the strand you pressed or a tip within 60 units of it.
- Cost: 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 water, set by the depth of the strand pressed.
- A dig that occupies no new cell is refunded, with the toast "Nothing new that way - try another strand".
- The screen answers four questions before you touch it:
  - Which strand? Any living strand can grow, so branch points are the maze's currency.
  - Which way? East is the goal; down is where the materials and the reach payout are.
  - Is that detour worth it? The price chip shows the cost, and a seam or pocket shows its value.
  - Am I about to cross a heat line or enter a green sight ring?

A RUN (45-60 s on leg 1; 2.5-4 min by leg 8).
- Start at the WESTERN hill with a full tank (64 + upgrades) and your kit.
- Follow galleries east and links down toward the island's taproot. The needle shows the way if you bought the compass; otherwise the standing instruction "Island ->" is enough.
- Detour to water pockets (+10 fuel) and seams (Phosphorus, or a deep material that later rungs need).
- Route around worm and mould rings. Throw a flask when worms latch on; cut the rot when the mould lands.
- The run ends at the taproot (ISLAND), when the tank runs dry, when the rot clock runs out, or when you tap Spore. Every ending pays in full.

A SESSION (5-15 min).
- 4-8 runs. In the first 10 runs every store visit buys at least one thing.
- Each retry of a leg shows your MARK (the farthest east you have reached) and, from M6, the FOSSIL of your last colony.
- The title and end screen always name the next goal ("Island 3 is 34 m past your mark", "Grow strength: 6 P short").
- Early on, an island falls every 3-6 runs.

THE JOURNEY (3-5 h).
- Ten legs, each a fresh world (seeds chosen by hand for Journey 1) with one named rule.
- Taproots go deeper (22 -> 158 m) and farther east (110 -> 410 m), so the journey walks the player down through all four bands.
- Power rungs past the first two need the material from the depth they open. That keeps "go down to afford going right" true from leg 3 on.

THE LONG TAIL.
- New Journeys: random seeds, one stacking rule each, and a colony tint for each journey finished.
- The Daily Dig: a shared seed, a fixed kit, depth as the score, and a streak.
journey:
STRUCTURE
- A journey is 10 legs. A leg is one 504-column streamed world (the 21 x 24-column grid is unchanged), seeded by (journey, leg).
- The hill sits at the WEST: home chunk 1, root column 36 (CONFIG.mine.journey.homeChunk; mineHomeChunk 21576; buildLevel 19412 reads layout.homeCol instead of cols>>1).
- The island is at the EAST, and under it hangs its TAPROOT: a glowing knot drawn on the canvas in a carved chamber 2.5 cells in radius, at (hill + east m, depth m).
- Reaching it means any clean colony node within 54 units (1.5 cells) of the knot's centre. The run then ends as 'island': the island's own drawn filaments pulse up to the island hill, which fruits (startCelebration 33442 with the island side). That is the owner's "reach one, resurface and spore".
- The next leg starts from that island, drawn as the new western hill. Failing leaves you on the same leg with the same seed, so a retry is mastery.
- The 1-chunk strip west of the hill exists but holds nothing special.

GENERATOR
The island chunk only; the layout is guarded by layout.journey, so classic #mine,<seed> maps and their mine-check pins do not move.
- Carve the taproot chamber with its own hash-seeded rng, never the chunk rng, so the carve call order is unchanged.
- Run the flood-and-repair pass generalized from 21995-22064: flood from the chamber and, if no gallery-seam cell is reached, open the shortest radius-1.7 connectors.
- Nothing is reserved, so no corridor shows (the owner rejected corridors twice).
- The island hill is drawn by drawMineHill/mineHillSpan (40096-40113), generalized to a list, using the goalhill/goalbush art.
- Journey 1 seeds are chosen per leg by tests/bots/legprobe.cjs from 50 candidates. The pick is the seed whose journey-bot runs-to-complete is closest to the target, provided the flood reaches the taproot and the shortest mask path is 1.3-2.0x the straight line.
- Journeys 2+ use hash(journeySeed, leg), with the mineChunkRng mixing.

LEG TABLE (CONFIG.mine.journey.legs)
Columns: name; taproot east (m) / chunks; taproot depth (m); rule; loadout the leg is tuned against; target runs to complete.
- 1 The Shallows: 110 / 4.6; 22 m; standard; bare -> Water 1; 2-5 runs.
- 2 Wet Ground: 140 / 5.8; 36 m; pockets x2 in bands 1-2 (teaches fuel detours); Water 2, Grow 3; 3-6 runs.
- 3 The Worm Galleries: 170 / 7.1; 50 m, past the first price line and into the worm band; worms x2 in band 2; + flask, Heat 1; 3-7 runs.
- 4 Coal Seam: 200 / 8.3; 62 m; anthracite seams x2 in band 2; Grow 4 (needs Anthracite); 4-8 runs.
- 5 Blight Line: 230 / 9.6; 76 m; mould also in band 2 (1 cloud per chunk); + enzyme; 4-9 runs.
- 6 Dry Reach: 260 / 10.8; 90 m, in the mould band; no water pockets in band 1, so the fuel is deeper; Water 4; 5-10 runs.
- 7 Hot Rock: 290 / 12.1; 104 m; heat lines 8 m shallower (safeDepth 34); Heat 3 (needs Garnet); 5-11 runs.
- 8 Garnet Deep: 330 / 13.8; 120 m; clouds x2 in band 3, garnet seams +1 richer; Grow 5 (needs Garnet); 6-12 runs.
- 9 The Iron Floor: 370 / 15.4; 140 m, in the hematite band; worms x1.5 in band 4; Water 6, Heat 4 (need Hematite); 6-13 runs.
- 10 The Promised Land: 410 / 17.1 (island column 446, inside the 504-column grid); 158 m; +1 worm and +1 cloud per chunk in bands 2-4, and the island is drawn as a big hill with more trees; near-max loadout; 6-15 runs.

Rows 1-10 are about 70-90 runs in total. Rules apply as overrides onto the cfg clone in configForLevel (mine block 32461-32493). They only change existing knobs: threatBands, reservoirsPerBand (made per-band), pilesPerBand, heat.safeDepth, and a richness bias. Band 1 stays threat-free on every leg, and nothing respawns.

THE ENDING
- Reaching leg 10's taproot plays the finale: every island on the journey strip fruits in turn (startCelebration per island, about 1 s each).
- The wordmark grows BLOOM, the line reads "Ten islands. The colony is everywhere now.", and the credits follow.
- The title then shows "Journey 1 complete" and unlocks a colony tint (amber) and New Journey.

AFTER THE ENDING
New Journey N uses random seeds and keeps the store. Its rules stack:
- J2 Drought: pockets give 7 instead of 10.
- J3 Fever: heat lines 10 m shallower.
- J4 Blight: mould from band 2.
- J5 Swarm: worm seeding x2.
- J6+: all of the above, and the island distance +10% per further journey (capped at column 480).
Each completed journey unlocks a colony tint (amber, violet, rose, ice), drawn by the colony renderer through one colour parameter. The Daily Dig continues in parallel.

PERSISTENCE AND UI
- Save: p.mineJourney = {journey, leg, journeySeed, legs: {[leg]: {mark, bestDepth, runs, fossil}}, tints}, with a default-on-read in loadProgress 13685. No migration flag is needed, because a missing value means leg 1.
- Journey strip: 10 dots, the current one lit, shown on the title (mineMenu 29737: "Continue - Leg 3 of 10 - The Worm Galleries - Island 3 is 170 m east, 50 m down - your mark 124 m"), on the end screen and in the store header.
- Routes: the plain URL's DIG opens the journey; #leg,<journey>,<leg> is the route for checks; #mine,<seed> stays the classic centre-hill descent, which the Daily reuses.
economy:
CURRENCIES
The rule is: "Every rung costs Phosphorus; rungs past the first two also need the material from the depth they unlock." Phosphorus (P) is the general currency. Anthracite (A) is band 2 (42-84 m), Garnet (G) band 3 (84-126 m), Hematite (H) band 4 (126-168 m).

SOURCES (every ending banks all of them)
1. SEAMS pay their own material.
   - Band 1 seams pay 3 P.
   - Deep seams pay 3-5 A, 3-5 G or 3-6 H. Richness comes from hash(seed, chunk, spotIndex) with weights 50/35/15 (H 6 at 5%), not from the chunk rng, so layout determinism is kept.
   - Stamped as pile.mineN at 22113-22131. mineOreRewards (22399-22404) pays pile.mineN, and the oreBonus is removed.
   - Deep seams still pay no P (the recorded rule is kept): depth pays P through reach instead.
2. REACH PAYOUT, banked in presentMineEnd 33215 as its own end-screen line: P = 2 + floor(reachM / 8).
   - reachM = the running maximum of clean depth + the running maximum of east distance from the hill.
   - In classic mode east is replaced by lateral distance either way.
   - Running maxima mean rot never erases progress (state.mineMaxDepth / state.mineMaxEast, updated in mineFrame 37307).
3. ISLAND BONUS: 10 x leg P + floor(water left / 2) P. Arriving with water to spare pays, so efficient routes are rewarded.
4. DAILY DIG: seams as normal plus half the reach payout. It feeds the journey but is never the best way to farm.

WATER (not a currency)
- 64 start (retuned from 84 so that run 1 is 45-60 s at a 1.5 s/dig human pace, about 32 digs).
- Pockets: +10 once each, 1 per band per chunk (the leg rule changes this).
- Worms drain 0.2 per second per attached worm through mineDrainDebt, so the tank stays whole numbers.

INCOME TARGETS BY STAGE (verified by journey.cjs in M7)
- Leg 1 (runs 1-4): 18-30 P a run (seams 6-12, reach 12-18); 0-6 A if the player dives.
- Legs 2-3 (runs 5-14): 30-45 P + 3-10 A a run; islands +20 / +30 plus water.
- Legs 4-6 (runs 15-40): 45-65 P + 6-12 A + 4-10 G a run; islands +40 to +60.
- Legs 7-10 (runs 41-85): 60-90 P + A/G + 4-10 H a run; islands +70 to +100.
- About 6,000 P over the journey against about 4,950 P of demand.
- Store copy: "64 water - grow 2 - a dig costs 2, then 4 / 8 / 16 past 42 / 84 / 126 m".

THE STORE
11 tracks and 38 rungs, all through upgradeInGame 14249. Prices are written P or P+material. costParts 14313 becomes a list of parts, and buyUpgrade 14323 checks and debits every part.

POWER
- Water, +12 each (64 -> 136): 5 | 20 | 60+6A | 110+10A | 180+10G | 280+10H. MINE_COSTS 14246 is replaced by this.
- Grow strength, 2 -> 7 steps: 12 | 70+8A | 150+10G | 260+10H | 400+16H.
- Heat tolerance, +14 m a rung, 4 rungs (the first line moves 42 -> 98 m, so the deepest band always costs x4 or x8): 25 | 90+10A | 190+12G | 300+10H.

KIT (the number you carry, restocked every descent; a miss costs nothing)
- Mucus flask (1/2/3): 10 | 50 | 140+8A.
- Cutting enzyme (1/2/3): 20 | 80+6A | 200+8G.
- Oxalic acid (1/2/3, M8): 80+6A | 180+8G | 320+8H.

KNOWLEDGE (compasses, M5)
- Island compass: bearing 20 | +distance 70.
- Water dowser: bearing 25 | +distance 70.
- Anthracite compass: 30 | 90 | biggest 160+4A.
- Garnet compass: 80+4A | 160 | 260+4G.
- Hematite compass: 120+4G | 240 | 380+4H.

CUT, with a refund: Ore yield (a compounding multiplier that changed no decision and quietly quadrupled deep materials) and Water pockets. Also cut: Heat tolerance rungs 5-6. migrateProgress 13719 under flag migratedMineStoreV2 refunds every removed rung at the price paid, in P and materials. The upgradeLevel clamp (14284) would otherwise strip paid rungs silently.

WHERE THE MATERIALS ARE SPENT
- Anthracite: Water r3-4, Grow r2, Heat r2, Flask r3, Enzyme r2, Acid r1, A-compass r3, G-compass r1 (62 A in total).
- Garnet: Water r5, Grow r3, Heat r3, Enzyme r3, Acid r2, G-compass r3, H-compass r1 (56 G).
- Hematite: Water r6, Grow r4-5, Heat r4, Acid r3, H-compass r3 (58 H).

PURCHASE CADENCE
- Runs 1-10: at least one rung on every visit. About 10 rungs are P-only and total about 240 P (Water 1-2, Grow 1, Heat 1, Flask 1, Enzyme 1, Island compass 1-2, Dowser 1, A-compass 1).
- Run 1 always buys Water r1 (5 P). A naive run still banks about 8 P: reach 2 + 3, plus a seam.
- Runs 11-40: about 13 rungs, one every 2-2.5 runs, gated by Anthracite and Garnet.
- Runs 41-85: about 15 rungs, one every 3 runs, gated by Garnet and Hematite.

EXHAUSTION
- The last rungs (Grow r5, H-compass r3, Acid r3) are what make the finale possible, so they land in legs 9-10.
- Target: at least 85% of rungs bought when the Promised Land is reached, and 100% no earlier than leg 9. The remainder falls in the first runs of New Journey 2.
- No material balance may exceed 3x its remaining demand at any point. Today 160 A are banked against a demand of 18.
runEnding:
EXACT RULES (checked every frame in mineFrame 37281; every one is a FULL PAYOUT of seams, reach and any bonus)

1. ISLAND
   - When: a clean node within 54 units of the taproot centre (mineIslandReached, right after mineDepthReached). The run ends that same frame.
   - Cause: 'island'.
   - Screen: the grown wordmark ISLAND, the number in plain type, and "The colony reached the island's root. Leg 4, Coal Seam, starts there."

2. DRY, as today
   - When: water is below the cheapest dig anywhere (mineCheapestCost 22686) for OUT_OF_FUEL_GRACE_MS 1600, with any water that arrives cancelling it.
   - Cause: 'dry'.
   - Copy: "Out of water. The colony fruits and spores."

3. STALLED: the soft-lock fix, mineFuelCheck 22703
   - When: water is below costHere, the price at the focus strand (state._mineFocus, falling back to the deepest clean tip), which is what the chip already quotes.
   - What happens: the dig-cost chip becomes the SPORE button (#hud-spore, pulsing, with a 5 s ring countdown).
   - A successful dig from any cheaper strand, or any water gained, cancels it. At zero the run ends.
   - Cause: 'dry', variant 'stalled'.
   - Copy: "Out of water for this depth. The colony fruits and spores."
   - Measured motivation: 14 of 39 bot runs and 5 of 12 playtest runs sat live at 2-7 water against 4-8 a dig. Nobody crawls back to the surface to spend 2.

4. SPORE / FRUIT-NOW
   - When: the player taps #hud-spore, or gear > "Spore now". The gear item replaces End run and forceFruitAbandon 33063 is routed through mineEndRun. The run ends at once.
   - Cause: 'spored'.
   - Copy: "You called it. The colony fruits where it stands."
   - This merges and replaces the old 'abandon' and its wrong "The colony was eaten" line (presentMineEnd 33227, showMineEnd 29301).

5. INFECTED
   - When: the 20 s colony-wide deadline runs out (mineInfectionCheck 22582), and it is 30 s the first time ever on a save.
   - Cause: 'infected'.
   - Copy: "The rot took the colony. What it had spored is yours."
   - The depth reported and recorded is state.mineMaxDepth, not the depth of the surviving clean tissue, so rot no longer under-reports progress (107 m used to read as 99).

6. FULL
   - When: a mine node cap of 9000, set in configForLevel instead of the shared 6000 (2718), is reached. The next refused dig ends the run.
   - Cause: 'full'.
   - Copy: "The colony has grown as far as it can. It fruits and spores."
   - Today the cap refuses every dig with "Solid rock that way" while the tank is still full.

MENU (mine only, settings markup 26396-26406)
- 'Replay tutorial' is hidden, because it restarted the run with no payout.
- 'Save & exit' is removed, because it deleted the run and its haul. A descent is one sitting and the store is the persistence.
- Music, Sound, haptics and the Event log remain.

OTHER CONDITIONS
- Collision gate: until sub._rockSolidified, revealMap 32266 keeps the curtain up (at most 15 s, "Settling the rock...") and mineGrow refuses without charging. No run can start inside rock.
- The Dev: maps misfire that destroyed a run cannot happen once the dev UI is gated.

END SCREEN (showMineEnd 29281)
- The wordmark (SPORED, or ISLAND / BLOOM), sized to fit 390 px, then one cause line.
- Count-up rows, each ticking up over 400 ms with a 250 ms stagger:
  - "Seams +9 Phosphorus - +8 Anthracite"
  - "Reach 96 m down, 40 m east -> +19 Phosphorus"
  - "Island bonus +30 - water carried +12"
- ONE next-goal line, in priority order:
  1. an affordable rung ("You can buy: Water +12 for 5 P");
  2. otherwise the island distance ("Island 2 is 34 m past your mark");
  3. otherwise the nearest rung ("Grow strength: 6 P short").
- One button, "To the store".
- The Phosphorus icon is sized by .ss-win-earned .ss-ri at 0.95em (CSS 1760-1767), and every material is named.
threatsAndCounters:
Each threat is placed per chunk per band (a density, not a population). Band 1 is empty on every leg, nothing respawns, sight is 300 units, and the rings stay the flat green 120,155,45 at 0.15 with no fifth treatment.

WORMS (from band 2)
- Seeding: 1 per chunk in band 2, 1 in band 3, 2 in band 4 (threatBands 3530), times the leg multiplier.
- Crawl: 1.0 cell per tick toward a strand in sight.
- Drain: while attached, 0.2 water per second each (mineDrainDebt).
- Breeding: 5% per second while attached, but only while fewer than 6 are attached. This is a mine branch at stepNematodes 17702. It replaces the global 16 cap, which silently stopped all breeding once 4 chunks had been seeded.
- Readable:
  - attached worms are drawn at 2x, with a pulsing tether to the strand they drain (drawNematodes 40150);
  - attached worms that are off screen get an edge marker, using the needle renderer the compasses share;
  - the HUD chip "3 -0.6/s" is a button that pans to the nearest attached worm.
- Decisive: rules are below under MUCUS FLASK.

MUCUS FLASK (the answer to worms; mineUseExcrete 22549, mine branch)
- One flask KILLS every worm within 80 units (actions.excrete.range) of any strand. Toast: "Mucus burst - 3 worms killed."
- Before this, one flask was a 0.5 s stun needing 3 hits and saved 0.1 water.
- Because nothing respawns, one flask ends that problem for good.
- The decision is timing: throw early and kill fewer, or wait while they breed at 5% per second and drain.

MOULD (from band 3)
- Seeding: 1 cloud per chunk in bands 3 and 4 (leg rules add band 2).
- Readable: a mine-only moveSpeed of 0.6 cells per tick, down from 2.5, is applied through CONFIG.mine.trych onto cfg.trichoderma in configForLevel 32476-32478. A cloud that senses you at the edge of its ring now takes at least 6-7 s to arrive (it used to lunge in 1.6 s). Routing around the ring is a skill again, and backing off works.
- Contact: the campaign breach machinery is kept beside the mine rules and not replaced: firstTouchRings 12, a disc, and descendants claimed. The mine overrides freshGrowthRings to 24 (from 80), so one breach is a wound, not most of the colony.
- The clock: one colony-wide 20 s timer, derived from "is anything infected". Two breaches need two cures. Infected strands cannot be grown from. 30 s on a save's first infection ever.
- The teeth: the run ends early. On a leg, that usually means losing this attempt at the island.
- Clouds still eat seams they can see when no strand is in sight, so a visible race for a garnet seam stays in the game.

CUTTING ENZYME (the answer to mould; mineUseAmputate 22563, mine branch)
- Arm the dose, then tap anywhere near the rot. The dose removes the whole connected infected component nearest the tap (within 300 units), walking parent and child links between infected nodes, plus one ring of clean margin. Removal uses the existing _removeNodes 16943 and ghostStrands.
- Because everything downstream of rot is already rotten, a cut never orphans clean tissue.
- One dose cures one breach, however far it has spread. Before this, one dose covered 37 of 44 rotten strands and 79 of 150.
- A miss (no rot within 300 units) costs nothing.
- Decisions: whether to carry doses at all (they are bought), and when mould is on screen, whether to route away or accept a breach and spend a dose.
- Tile copy: "A dose cuts out one patch of rot - all of it, wherever it spread."

HEAT (priced, never enforced)
- The ladder is 2 / 4 / 8 / 16, with lines at 42 / 84 / 126 m (maxMult 8). Tolerance is +14 m a rung, to a maximum of +56 m, so heat never disappears from a 168 m shaft (today it can be pushed to 192 m, i.e. deleted).
- The beat names it: "42 m - ANTHRACITE - digs now cost 4", and a separate small beat fires whenever the price moves off a band line.
- Integrity: growDirected 16249 gets a strictTip option, so the fallthrough at 16290 only considers tips within 60 units of the pressed strand. This closes the measured 8x bypass, where pressing a walled 6-36 m strand grew at 137-142 m and charged 2.

OXALIC ACID (the owner-sanctioned rock-through consumable, M8)
- Arm a vial, then tap a rock face within one grow reach of a clean strand. It dissolves a disc of radius 1.6 cells (58 units) for the rest of the run.
- mineDissolve clears _fineSolid, _coarseCover and cell.rock in the disc and records it in sub._mineHoles. solidifyMineRock 39234 re-applies the holes after any restamp. drawLevelRocks 39288 draws each hole as a soil-coloured disc with an etched rim.
- Water pocket cells are left alone. A miss costs nothing. Rock stays a wall by default.
- Decisions: the generator's stranded seams (2 of 24) and pockets (1 of 12) become targets, and one wall on the way east can become a shortcut. It works like a Spelunky bomb: you rewrite the maze once per vial.
onboarding:
PRINCIPLE: teach by doing, in the world, once. The owner's data showed that campaign onboarding polish did nothing, so there are no modal tutorials. Every tip is a one-shot persisted in p.mineTips, and each is logged as a 'tutorial' telemetry event with detail.

THE FIRST 5 MINUTES
- 0:00. The load gate says "Tap to start" on touch devices (not CLICK). The title shows one DIG button, "Journey 1 - Leg 1 of 10", the journey strip, and "Reach the green island to the east. Water is your fuel."

- 0:05. First frame: the hill at the west edge, the root, and a small "Island ->" tag at the right edge of the surface. It is a standing instruction with no bearing or distance, so the compass still has something to sell. Two teaching aids:
  - A GHOST DRAG, drawn on the canvas: a translucent fingertip presses the root, drags 110 px down and to the right along a dashed arrow, lifts, and repeats every 1.8 s until the first successful dig.
  - #minehint, its own element above the kit, reads "Drag from the colony to dig". The old .hint is display:none below 760 px (CSS about 693/1011), so the first-ever phone player saw nothing.
  A tap on the colony also digs, straight down.

- First dig. The ghost stops; the water number ticks down 2 and the "2 a dig" chip flashes once.

- First seam in view. An in-world label under it: "Phosphorus - grow onto it". When it pays, a floater "+3 P" rises from the seam with a ping.

- First pocket in view. Label: "Water +10". When tapped, a "+10" floater and a glug, and the pocket's art dims so spent pockets read as spent.

- Two refusals in a row, or a refunded no-new-ground dig. The 3 best frontier strands pulse for 3 s (the longest clear ray into unexplored ground, found with the free solidAtWorld), with the toast "Try another strand". This is what fixes the naive "always dig from the bottom" player (median 28 m today).

- Within 6 m of the first heat line, first time only. A label on the line: "Past 42 m every dig costs 4". The crossing beat then says "digs now cost 4".

- First run end (about 0:50). The count-up rows show that depth and distance paid ("Reach 70 m -> +10 P"). The next-goal line reads "You can buy: Water +12 for 5 P". There is one button.

- First store visit. Exactly TWO tiles, Water (5 P, highlighted) and Grow strength (12 P), plus DESCEND above the fold.

- Runs 2-4.
  - Your mark flag shows where run 1 got to, with a "Past your mark!" beat and sound.
  - The first worm ring seen gets a label "Worm - drains water if it reaches you. Stay out of the green."
  - The first cloud seen gets "Mould - one touch starts a 20 s rot clock."
  - Island 1 is usually reached on run 2-5 (median 3): celebration, bonus, and "Leg 2: Wet Ground" lights on the strip.

PROGRESSIVE STORE REVEAL
upgradeInGame 14249 is the single predicate for both the shelf and the buy path, and it reads p.mineSeen flags that mineFrame sets.
- Water and Grow strength: from the first visit.
- Heat tolerance: after the first 42 m crossing.
- Mucus flask: after the first worm is seen or attaches.
- Cutting enzyme: after the first cloud is seen.
- Island compass and Water dowser: after run 2.
- Each material compass: after the first seam of that material is dug.
- Oxalic acid: after leg 2 is completed.
A newly revealed tile carries a "NEW" tag for one visit. The title's Upgrades button appears when any rung is affordable, not only when P > 0 (29889).
feedbackAndJuice:
All visuals are drawn on the canvas or reuse existing art; all audio is synthesized with Web Audio oscillators and noise. Everything respects isSfxMuted, and every cue is counted through __game.sfx().counts() so the checks can assert it without hearing it.

FLOATERS
- mineOreRewards and mineWaterPickups return [{x, y, mat, n}] instead of bare totals.
- addEnergyFloater 38540 and drawFloaters 38612 take an icon and a colour. The bolt icon and green text are hard-coded today.
- Material floaters: "+3 P" in #c9a2e8, "+4 Anthracite" in #d8b36a, Garnet in #d8566a, Hematite in #d98a5a. Water: "+10" in water blue.
- They rise 40 px over 900 ms in bold 16 px with an outline.

SEAM READABILITY
- Every unclaimed seam gets a halo in its material's tint and a small material glyph, so a garnet seam no longer looks like a phosphorus one.
- The halo grows with richness (pile.mineN).
- Tapped pockets dim.

SOUNDS (new functions in __m_render_sfx 24820-24985)
- Seam: a sine ping, 120 ms, exponential decay. Base pitch by material (P 660 Hz, A 523, G 784, H 440), rising one semitone for each further seam in the same run, capped at +12. This is the Mr Driller escalation.
- Pocket: a falling triangle "glug", 330 -> 220 Hz, through a lowpass.
- Band beat: a 110 + 55 Hz gong with a 1.2 s decay.
- Price change: two 20 ms square ticks at 1200 Hz.
- Refused dig: a 90 Hz thud, 60 ms.
- Worm attach: a 180 Hz saw through a bandpass, 40 ms (a squelch).
- Rot under 10 s: a 60 Hz heartbeat pulsing twice a second, the same as the HUD's .urgent state (27215).
- Flask: a noise whoosh with a highpass sweep. Enzyme: a double snip. Acid: a 3 kHz band-passed fizz.
- Island: a triangle arpeggio 523/659/784/1046 Hz, then the chord. Spored or dry: a soft 3-note chord over 800 ms.
- Buy: an 880 -> 1320 Hz chime. Mark crossed: a rising 3 notes.

HAPTICS (navigator.vibrate, when supported and SFX are on; a separate toggle arrives in M10)
- Seam 10 ms, pocket 20 ms, worm attach 30 ms, island [40, 60, 40, 60, 120].

BEATS (showMineBeat 37258, one at a time)
- "42 m - ANTHRACITE - digs now cost 4".
- "Past your mark!".
- "ISLAND IN SIGHT", when the island hill enters the view.
- "Island 3 - 40 m", when rung 2 of the island compass first reads 40 m or less.
- mineBeat (37244) reads state.config, not CONFIG.

MARK AND FOSSIL
- The MARK, per leg, is the farthest east reached: a dashed vertical line with a surface flag reading "your mark - 124 m" (M4).
- The FOSSIL is the previous attempt's colony: up to 600 points (x and y quantized to cells, plus parent index, about 8 KB) saved per (journey, leg) at run end, drawn at 20% alpha, desaturated, under the live colony (M6).
- In the Daily Dig, a horizontal dashed line marks today's best depth.

END SCREEN
- The payout counts up by source (seams, reach, island), then shows one next-goal line.
- The red all-caps call to action is removed.
- The labelled earnings replace the unlabelled dots.

HUD (two rows on phones)
- Row 1: water, dig cost (or the SPORE button), depth, and east distance on legs.
- Row 2: the haul (P and named materials) on the left; threats (worms, rot clock) on the right.
- #gearbtn is position:fixed, outside the pill's flow, so it can never be pushed off screen.
- The dig-cost chip calls mineDigCost directly instead of window.__game.mine.costHere() (27194), so it no longer depends on a debug hook.
retention:
WHAT BRINGS A PLAYER BACK TOMORROW
1. THE DAILY DIG (M9).
   - One shared seed per UTC day, on the classic centre-hill descent: the original "go deeper" game, reused.
   - A fixed kit (tank 100, grow 3, 1 flask, 1 dose, standard heat), so the score (maximum depth) measures skill and can be compared.
   - A local best per day and a streak. It pays seams plus half the reach payout into the journey.
   - The online board is optional: it posts only if the Supabase host accepts mode 'mine-daily' after the owner's SQL migration, and otherwise shows 'local'. It never gates play.
   - Why: a small ritual to return to, which the CrazyGames benchmarks name as the day-1 lever, at almost no content cost.
2. A NEAR GOAL ON THE TITLE.
   - "Island 3 is 34 m past your mark" and "You can buy Grow strength".
   - Why: closing the tab should feel like pausing, not finishing.
3. THE LEG YOU ARE ON IS THE SAME MAP, with your mark and fossil on it.
   - Why: every attempt left visible progress. This is the Hades "every run counts" rule, delivered through mastery rather than grind.

WEEK ONE
- Journey 1: ten legs in about 3-5 hours of play, with the first island at minutes 5-10 and legs 2-3 in the first session.
- Each leg is a new world with one named rule, so every session holds a "first": a new band, a new threat, a new rule, a new store tile or a new island.
- The Promised Land is a REAL ending, with the finale, the credits and a tint.
- The store is sized to be about 85% bought at that point, so the store never becomes the goal in its own right.
- New Journeys: random seeds, stacking rules and a tint per journey. This is the Balatro stakes / Slay the Spire ascension shape, and it reuses all the content.

DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT
- Missions and quests: a second goal system competing with the island, and the owner's "too complex" rule.
- Login bonuses, energy timers and offline "island fruiting" income: they reward absence, and the owner said loss must not hurt.
- Pick-1-of-3 or chosen run modifiers: that is drafting.
- Achievement lists and a field journal: deferred; the journey strip is the achievement track.
- Cosmetic shops: deferred.
- A global leaderboard as a core system: it needs owner-run SQL and has no anti-cheat.
- Any lose-your-haul push-your-luck mechanic: every ending stays a full payout.

premiseChanges: CHANGE, to the affordability clause inside the settled heat premise ('the price is set where the dig starts, affordability asks the cheapest ground'; mineCheapestCost 22686). The run still ends on the cheapest ground anywhere, but it now ALSO ends 5 s after the tank cannot pay the price where the player is working (the focus strand). The SPORE chip counts down those 5 s, and a dig from any cheaper strand or any water cancels it. EVIDENCE: 14 of 39 bot runs and 5 of 12 playtest runs soft-locked at 2-7 water against a 4-8 price, including 3 of 8 first runs. Two runs sat 30 s with no end and 0 affordable strands on screen. The 'recovery play' of crawling back to the surface never happened. Heat stays priced and never enforced: no dig the game allows is punished, and all that is removed is dead time.

INTERPRETATION, flagged for the owner, of plan item 07 ('reach one, resurface and spore'). A leg is won by reaching the island's TAPROOT, a drawn root chamber under the island at the leg's depth. The colony does not have to grow back up to the island's surface. The island's own filaments carry it up in the celebration, so the colony still resurfaces and spores from the island. EVIDENCE: a dig is priced at its source (mineGrowCost), so climbing 90 m to the surface costs about 76 water at base heat. That would tax exactly the depth the later legs ask for, and a point target is what the island compass can name through rock. If the owner insists on a literal surface arrival, keep every taproot at 30 m or shallower.

pitch: THE DEEP MINE: you grow a glowing fungal colony down and across a rock maze on one tank of water. Every dig costs water, and the price doubles each time the earth heats up (2/4/8/16 past 42/84/126 m). When you can no longer pay, the colony fruits: the spores pay for how deep you got and what you dug out, and you buy one thing that makes the next run visibly better. You choose each run: dive for Phosphorus and rare minerals, or push east through the maze to the next green island. There are eight islands between you and the Promised Land. LOOP IN ONE LINE: dig until dry -> spores pay out -> buy one upgrade -> go deeper, or farther east.
coreLoop:
A DIG (1.5-2.5 s at a human pace). Press a strand and drag. The arrow shows the reach: 153 world units at grow 2, 459 at grow 6. Release, and the strands reveal over about 1 s with the grow sound. The tank drops by the price the HUD quotes (2/4/8/16). Each new metre of clean depth feeds the reach payout, and every payout tick pops a small '+1 P' at the tip. A tap on a strand digs straight down. Every dig is a routing decision: which strand to dig from, which corridor to take, whether to detour to a seam (+3 P or +2 of a material) or a pocket (+10 water, once), and how to stay out of the green sensing washes.

A RUN (run 1: 35-45 digs in 50-75 s; mid: 50-70 digs in 90-150 s; late: 70-100 digs in 2.5-4 min). Each run has one intent.
- DIVE: earns Phosphorus from depth plus the band's material.
- PUSH EAST: advances toward this leg's island, collects band-0 seams on the way, and pays the island bonus on arrival.
Things met on the way:
- Heat lines, where the price doubles, announced by the band beat.
- Worms below 42 m. Each drains 0.2 water/s, and one flask kills them all.
- Mould below 84 m. Contact starts one 20 s rot clock, and one enzyme dose cures one breach.
A run ends when you cannot pay (dry or Fruit now), when the rot clock runs out, when you reach the island, when the node cap is hit, or when you quit. Every ending pays in full.

BETWEEN RUNS (2 taps or fewer). The end screen counts the payout up by source, names the next goal, and offers the best affordable rung with an inline Buy. Descend is the primary button, and the full store is one tap away.

A SESSION (5-12 min). 3-6 runs. For the first 10 runs, at least one purchase every store visit. At least one 'first' per session: a new band, a new threat and its tile, an island in sight or reached, or a new compass needle. The session ends on a named near goal.

THE JOURNEY (1.5-3 h, about 40-60 runs). Eight legs east. Each leg's world is fixed, so a retry is mastery, and the last attempt's colony is drawn in the ground as a fossil. Each island gives a bonus and a ROOTED celebration. The Promised Land ends Journey 1 with credits.

THE LONG TAIL. New Journey, with one added rule per journey and a unique colony colour for each journey completed. Colony colours are the late sink for Phosphorus. Island colonies fruit while you are away. The daily dig carries a streak.
journey:
SHAPE. Journey 1 has 8 legs.
- Each leg is a fresh 504-column x 168-row world: 21 chunks of 24 columns, unchanged from today.
- It is seeded by legSeed = mix(journey, leg), using the same mixing as mineChunkRng (21587). The seed is identical for every player and every retry, so a failed leg is learned, not rerolled.
- HOME (the hill, which on legs 2+ is the previous island) sits at chunk 1 (about column 36, the WEST).
- THE ISLAND sits at chunk 1 + offset: a 12-column green hill on the surface with a pulsing spore beacon. drawMineHill/mineHillSpan (40096-40113) are generalised to draw a list of hills.
- The island gets its own head shaft, a mirror of the home head (21814-21825), down to the row-3 gallery.
- Reachability comes from flood-and-repair connectors: the descent repair generalised (21995-22064), plus a seam-to-seam lateral repair in the chunks between home and island. It is never a reserved corridor, which the owner rejected twice.
- A leg is reached when any clean strand is inside the island span within 1.5 cells of the surface. The run then ends with cause 'island': the ROOTED celebration plays (startCelebration 33442 with an 'island' side), you get the full payout plus the island bonus, and the next Descend starts leg N+1 from that island.
- Two layouts are kept. 'journey' is the legs. 'free' is today's layout (home in the middle, no island), used by #mine,<seed>, by the daily dig, and by the 190 existing mine-check assertions, which stay pinned to it.

WITHOUT A COMPASS you know one thing: the island is east. That is the standing instruction. On the first run after the island is named, a 5 s chevron at the east screen edge reads 'Island 1 is east' (no distance). Precision is sold: first bearing, then distance (M7).

| 2 | Worm Country | 6 | 144 m | ~41 (grow 3) | worms +1 in threatBands[1..2] (42-126 m) | 3-5 |

Total: about 40-60 runs, 1.5-3 h of play.
- The digs column assumes about 3.5/4.5/5.5/6.5 cells per lateral dig at grow 3/4/5/6. A navdive-east bot calibrates the offsets.

- From leg 3 the premise bites: grow 4-6 and heat tolerance are priced in Anthracite and Garnet, which only depth yields, so you go DOWN to afford going RIGHT.

PER-LEG RECORDS.
- Farthest east and deepest, both drawn as dashed lines in the world.
- The last failed attempt's colony, drawn as a dim fossil (at most 300 sampled points, cleared when the island is reached).
- The core: a clean strand at 160 m or deeper pays +20 P once per leg.

BUILD ORDER. M6 ships legs 1-3. After leg 3, row 3 repeats with the offset growing +2 chunks per leg (capped at 19), so the game never dead-ends. M9 authors legs 4-8 and the ending.

THE ENDING. Reaching the Promised Land plays this sequence:
1. The ROOTED wordmark.
2. The camera pulls back over the double hill.
3. A canvas-drawn journey strip, on which all 8 islands burst spores in turn, 300 ms apart, over a rising chord.
4. 'The Promised Land. Your colony spans the world.'
5. Credits (showCredits 32077).
6. A unique 'Promised' colony colour.

AFTER. Journey 2 starts at leg 1 on new seeds with one added rule, and the rules stack per journey:
- J2: worms breed 2x.
- J3: heat lines 6 m shallower.
- J4: pockets give +7, not +10.
- J5: +1 cloud in 84-168 m.

- J8 and later: endless, with all rules.
Each completed journey unlocks one unique colour. The store carries over. The daily dig ('free' layout, deepest wins) runs alongside the journey from M8.

SOURCES. All are banked in presentMineEnd (33215) on every ending.
1. REACH PAYOUT (new; CONFIG.mine.reachPay.perM [6,4,3,2]). +1 P per 6 m down to 42 m, per 4 m to 84 m, per 3 m to 126 m, per 2 m to 168 m. It is paid on the run's maximum clean depth.

runEnding:
A run ends in exactly one of seven ways. Every one goes mineEndRun(state, cause) -> presentRunOver -> presentMineEnd. All are died:false and all pay IN FULL: seams + reach + bonuses. The depth paid and recorded is the running maximum clean depth this run (state.mineMaxDepth, updated in mineFrame), so rot can never erase metres already dug. Today's infected endings under-report (107 m reached, 99 m shown).

1. 'dry'. Either of two conditions:
   (a) As today: water is below the cheapest dig anywhere (mineCheapestCost 22686) for 1.6 s. OUT_OF_FUEL_GRACE_MS (22702) still lets a strand in a pocket's reach pay out first.
   (b) NEW, THE SOFT-LOCK FIX: water is below the price at the focus strand (mineDigCost 22678 at state._mineFocus, which is the HUD's costHere). The run ends after 6 s (CONFIG.mine.stuckFruitMs 6000) with no successful dig and no water gain. The timer starts only once the last dig's reveal has finished (isRevealing false), and it pauses while a menu is open.
   Copy: 'Out of water at 92 m. The colony fruits and spores.'
2. 'fruit'. The player taps FRUIT NOW. The button appears whenever water is below costHere: bottom centre, 64 px tall, above the kit, pulsing, with a conic ring counting down the 6 s. Sub-label: 'Too dry to dig here'. Copy: 'The colony fruited at 92 m. Every spore is yours.'
3. 'infected'. The rot clock reaches 0. The clock is 20 s, or 30 s on a save's first infection. Copy: 'The rot took the colony at 92 m. What it spored is yours.'
4. 'abandon'. Settings > End run. forceFruitAbandon (33063) is routed to mineEndRun(state,'abandon') in the mine, so the line no longer says 'eaten'. Copy: 'You ended the descent at 92 m. Everything dug is banked.'
5. 'quit'. Settings > 'Fruit & exit', which replaces 'Save & exit' (today that deletes the run and its haul). It banks through the same mineBank(r) and returns to the title with a toast: '+23 P banked'. No end screen.
6. 'island'. A clean strand reaches the island's surface. The grown word is ROOTED. Copy: 'Your colony took root on Island 2. Leg 3 begins there.' The island bonus is added.
7. 'full'. The node cap is hit: the mine sets growth.maxNodes to 9000 in configForLevel, and the run ends at maxNodes - 30 instead of refusing every dig with 'Solid rock that way' while water remains. Copy: 'The colony has grown as far as it can. It fruits and spores.'

WHY THIS FIX. The soft lock is mineFuelCheck (22703) asking whether you can afford the SHALLOWEST strand (always 2, at the root) while the working front costs 4-16. That left 36% of runs live and idle. The fix keeps the recovery play the rule was written for: a successful shallow dig moves the focus, which cheapens costHere and resets the timer. It also never leaves a run idle for more than 6 s, and it makes the ending one obvious tap.

INFECTION.
- One clock per colony, derived from 'is anything infected' (mineInfectionCheck 22582).
- It stops only when every infected strand is gone.
- Infected strands cannot be grown from.
- A top-centre banner reads 'ROT 14 s - tap the enzyme, then the rot', or '... the colony will fruit' with an empty bag.
- When it expires the whole colony turns green and pays in full. That is the interlock: Amputate is bought and the ending pays in full.

  - The HUD chip shows the count and the rate ('2  -0.4/s'), and a tap on it pans to the nearest attached worm.

  - The green flat sensing rings are unchanged. The attach ring is a separate mark, not a fifth sensing treatment.

MUCUS FLASK (bought, carry 1-3, restocked every descent).
- Mine-only overrides on the config clone in configForLevel (32461-32493): nematodes.killHits 3 -> 1, and actions.excrete.range 80 -> 200.
- One tap kills every worm within 200 units of any strand, and the drain reads 0/s on the next tick. Today one flask saved 0.1 water.
- A miss costs nothing. Copy: 'Mucus burst - 3 worms killed.'
- WHY DECISIVE: the threat is a visible rate on the HUD, and one tap sets it to zero.

MOULD (84 m and below). Clouds keep the green flat sensing ring (unchanged look). Mine-only overrides:
- trichoderma.moveSpeed 2.5 -> 0.35 cells a tick, which is 5 cells/s -> 0.7 cells/s. A cloud needs about 12 s to cross its 300-unit ring, so routing around it becomes a real skill. Today players routing around clouds were still infected in 5 of 7 runs.
- firstTouchRings 12 -> 6. A breach claims about 8-15 strands, not 41-55.
- leavesPerRound 0. Clouds no longer eat the seams you were routing to.
Contact starts ONE colony clock: 20 s, or 30 s on a save's first infection (p.mineSeen.rot).
Rot creep at spreadDepthPerTurn 0.35 must be verified with tests/spread-probe.cjs; the breaker saw 50 rotten strands stay at 50 for 17 s. Fix it if it is absent.
READABLE: the rot banner, a heartbeat under 10 s, and a relief chime on a cure.

CUTTING ENZYME (bought, carry 1-3).
- mineUseAmputate (22563) removes ONLY infected strands within 260 units of the tap, through net._removeNodes (16943). Orphaned clean children keep living. It never takes clean tissue; today one cut took 118 strands to catch 6.
- No infected strand in range means a refusal, and the dose is kept.
- One dose cures one breach. Two breaches need two doses, so the owner's 'find all of it' rule holds.
- A TAP commits it; today only a >= 12 px drag does.
- Copy: 'Cut 11 rotten strands - the colony is clean.'
- WHY DECISIVE: the clock is on screen, and one aimed tap stops it.

OXALIC VIAL (the owner-sanctioned rock-through consumable; bought with Hematite, carry 1-3).
- Tap the vial and the aim arrow turns acid-yellow and outlines the rock it will cross.
- The next dig ignores rock for its first 4 segments (about 100 units, 3 cells or fewer), then grows normally. It works through a mine-only sub._acidSegments counter honoured in the growth collision path.
- It is pre-checked by sampling solidAtWorld along the aim. It is refused, and the vial kept, if open ground is not reached within 4 segments ('Too thick for the acid').
- The fine mask is NOT edited: strands are drawn over the rock with an etched halo, so no re-stamp path is needed.
- Uses: the walled-in seams and pockets the generator already leaves as bait, and shortcuts east through a plug.
- Rock stays a wall for everyone who has not bought one.

HEAT (the passive threat). Priced, never enforced; the staircase is unchanged. Tolerance is capped at +36 m, so the x8 zone always exists (lines 78/120/162 at most). The HUD always quotes the price.
onboarding:
THE FIRST 5 MINUTES. Taught by doing, never by a modal. Every tip is one non-blocking line, fires once per save (p.mineTips), and is logged as a 'tutorial' event for the funnel.

0:00. The load gate reads 'Tap to dig' on a coarse pointer and 'Click to dig' otherwise (showLoading 31857); the tap initialises audio. A FIRST VISIT SKIPS THE TITLE: the tap goes straight into leg 1, run 1 (enterGame 40423 -> beginMineRun), with no DIG word animation. Input goes live on reveal. Target: 1.5 s or less from tap to diggable; today it is 6.9 s.

0:01. The colony root pulses under the hill.
- A canvas-drawn GHOST FINGER (a mint dot with a trailing arrow) drags 110 px down the most open ray from the root, looping every 1.6 s.
- #minehint is the mine's own element, so the phone CSS rules (693/1011/1059) cannot hide it. It sits top centre under the HUD and reads 'Drag down from the colony to dig'.
- A tap on the colony also digs straight down.
- Nothing else is on screen: no kit, no second HUD row.

0:03. Dig 1: grow sound, and water 84 -> 82 with a '-2' tick. The hint becomes 'Every dig costs water. Dig as deep as you can.' for 3 s. The ghost leaves; it comes back only after 6 s with no dig on runs 1-2.

0:05-0:10. First reach tick at 6 m: '+1 P' pops at the tip with a soft tick, and the HUD P count rises. This teaches that depth pays.

0:10-0:25. The first Phosphorus seam comes on screen: a soft pulsing ring and 'Phosphorus - grow into it to collect'. When claimed, a '+3 Phosphorus' floater appears at the seam with a chime.

0:20-0:35. The first water pocket comes on screen: a ring and 'Water pocket - touch it for +10 water'. When tapped, a '+10 water' floater, a glug, and the pocket art drains, so a spent pocket reads as spent.

0:30-0:50. At 42 m the beat reads '42 m - ANTHRACITE' with a second line 'Digs now cost 4'. The soil turns black, the price chip pulses orange, and a hiss plays.

DEAD-END NUDGE (runs 1-5). If two digs in a row gain no depth and less than 2 cells of new ground: 'Dead end - dig from a glowing tip'. The two tips with the most open ground ahead (sampled in 8 directions) glow for 4 s.

0:50-1:15. At 3 digs left or fewer, the water chip turns amber and reads '3 left'. When the price here beats the tank, FRUIT NOW appears with its 6 s ring. The run ends on SPORED.

1:15. The run 1 end screen counts up 'Depth 70 m +14' and 'Phosphorus seams x2 +6', or shows a 'First spores' top-up to 12. It says 'Your first descent', shows the next-goal card 'Water tank: start with 12 more water - 10 P [Buy]', and offers [Descend] [Store]. From M6 it adds the tease line 'Far to the east lies Island 1. Reach it and your colony moves on.'

1:25. Run 2 opens with the 5 s chevron 'Island 1 is east' at the east edge. The first worm to attach (42 m or deeper) triggers 'A worm is drinking your water. Mucus flasks kill worms - in the store.', and the flask tile is revealed.

2:30-5:00. Runs 3-4. The island compass tile appears at store visit 2. The first mould contact gets the 30 s first clock and 'Rot! Cutting enzyme cuts it out - in the store.', and the enzyme tile is revealed. 'ISLAND 1 IN SIGHT' fires as a beat. Island 1 is typically reached on runs 3-5.

PROGRESSIVE STORE REVEAL. upgradeInGame (14249) reads p.mineSeen, and the shelf and the buy path share that one predicate.
- Visit 1: Water tank and Grow strength (2 tiles, one affordable choice).
- + Island compass at visit 2.
- + Heat tolerance when a strand first passes 42 m.
- + Mucus flasks at the first worm attach.
- + Cutting enzyme at the first mould contact, or a cloud within 300 units.
- + each material compass at that material's first seam.
- + Oxalic vial at leg 3 with Hematite held.
- + Colony colours at leg 5, or when 80% of the P power rungs are bought.
A newly revealed tile carries a 'NEW' badge and is the next-goal card's first pick. The store never shows more than 5 tiles before run 5.
feedbackAndJuice:
FLOATERS. drawFloaters (38612) is generalised to take an icon, a colour and a size. Floaters spawn at world positions, following the addEnergyFloater (38540) pattern. mineOreRewards (22376) and mineWaterPickups (22418) return per-pile {pile, mat, amount} lists so each floater spawns at its site.
- '+1 P': 12 px violet at the deepest tip, one per reach tick.
- '+3 Phosphorus': 18 px violet at the seam centre.
- '+2 Anthracite / Garnet / Hematite': in the material's tint.
- '+10 water': blue at the pocket.
- '-3 worms': at the flask burst.
- 'Cut 11': at the enzyme cut.

SOUNDS. Synthesized with Web Audio in __m_render_sfx (24820), following the click() pattern. All sit behind isSfxMuted, are counted in window.__sfx.counts so the checks can assert them, and never stack more than 6 voices.
- Dig: a short noise crunch, lowpassed by segment count.
- Reach tick: a sine blip rising from 880 to 1320 Hz with the band.
- Seam chime: two sines; Phosphorus 660+990 Hz, Anthracite 440, Garnet 587, Hematite 740. Each consecutive seam in a run steps up a semitone.
- Pocket: a glug (noise through a lowpass sweeping 800 -> 200 Hz, 250 ms).
- Price rise: a 3 kHz highpassed hiss, 400 ms.
- Band beat: a gong (110+220 Hz, 1.2 s decay).
- Worm attach: a wet click. Flask: a splat.
- Rot: a sting at contact, a heartbeat under 10 s (60 -> 120 bpm), and a relief chime on the cure.
- New best: a rising arpeggio. Island in sight: a sparkle.
- Run end: a chord, major for the island and suspended for every other ending.
- End screen: count-up ticks and a total ding. Buy: a coin chime.

HAPTICS. navigator.vibrate, feature-detected, behind a Settings toggle 'Vibration' persisted in mycelium.settings.v1 (saveSettings 32206-32209).
- 12 ms on a seam or pocket.
- 30 ms on a price line.
- [8, 40, 8] on a worm attach.
- 60 ms on reaching an island.

RECORDS IN THE WORLD.
- A dashed line across the world at your best depth (per leg), labelled 'Best 112 m' at the screen edge.
- A dashed vertical line at your farthest east on this leg.
- Crossing either fires a 'NEW BEST' beat and the arpeggio.
- From M6, the previous attempt's fossil is drawn dim under the colony.

STATE LEGIBILITY.
- Tapped pockets are drawn drained (35% alpha, a dry crack).
- Seams are tinted by material; the same leaf-litter art, no new art.
- The water chip turns amber and reads 'N left' at 3 digs left or fewer.
- The price chip pulses when the price changes.
- FRUIT NOW pulses, with its countdown ring.
- The rot banner, and the rings on attached worms.

CAMERA. A 3 px, 150 ms micro-shake on a price line, a flask burst and an island coming into sight, in mineFollowCamera (37198). Off under Settings 'Reduced motion'.

BAND BEATS (showMineBeat 37258).
- '42 m - ANTHRACITE' with a second line 'Digs now cost 4' wherever a price line coincides. With tolerance bought, the price line gets a beat of its own at its shifted depth.
- 'THE CORE +20 P' at 160 m, once per leg.
- 'ISLAND 2 IN SIGHT'.

END SCREEN (showMineEnd 29281).
1. The grown word (SPORED or ROOTED), scaled to the viewport width minus 32 px so it no longer clips at 390 px.
2. The depth, and one cause line.
3. Rows counting up, 400 ms each with ticks: 'Depth 92 m +21', 'Phosphorus seams x3 +9', 'Island bonus +40', 'First spores +N'.
4. Materials by full name, then the total and the new balance. The P icon is sized 0.95em (today it renders 55-170 px).
5. A records line: 'New deepest: 92 m', or 'Deepest 112 m - 20 m to go', or 'Farthest east on leg 2: 96 m'.
6. The NEXT-GOAL CARD: the best affordable rung by priority (new tile > grow > water > island compass > flask if worms were met > enzyme if rot was met > heat > material compasses > vial > colours), with an inline Buy. If nothing is affordable, the nearest rung with 'N P short'.
7. [Descend] as the primary button (1 tap to the next run) and [Store] as secondary.
8. The journey strip (from M6).
retention:
BENCHMARKS. The closest analogues are the fuel-and-upgrade distance games that dominate web portals:
- Hill Climb Racing: fuel is the clock, distance pays coins, there is an upgrade after run 1, and the best distance is a flag in the world.
- Learn to Fly, Burrito Bison and Dig to China: runs of 10-90 s, payout by distance, a purchase after nearly every early run, and a destination that ends the game after 1-3 h.
- Motherload: deeper ore pays more, and fuel is the limit.
- Mr. Driller: air is the clock.
- Spelunky's daily seed and Wordle's shareable daily result.
Portal targets from the phase 1 findings: CrazyGames wants an average session of 10+ minutes (the campaign was rejected at a 2:40 median played visit), and 10-15% D1.

TARGETS, read from telemetry after M8:
- 90% or more of gate taps dig within 30 s.
- 85% or more finish run 1.
- 70% or more of run-1 finishers start run 2. For comparison, 80% of campaign players never cleared level 1.
- Median played visit 6 min or more, mean 10 min or more.
- Island 1 reached by 40% or more of the players who start run 2.
- D1 12% or more, D7 4% or more.

FIRST HOUR (a committed player): about 20-25 runs, 15-20 purchases, islands 1-3, bands down to Garnet, worms by run 2, mould by run 4, and the island and Anthracite compasses.

FIRST WEEK: 20-30 min a day reaches legs 4-8 and the Promised Land around days 3-5, with the daily dig every day.

WHAT BRINGS THEM BACK, and why each one works:
1. THE JOURNEY EAST. A goal that ENDS. An island checkpoint means a failed run still leaves you further along. Retries on a fixed world turn failure into map knowledge, and the fossil makes that visible. (Slay the Spire acts; Dig to China's destination.)
2. THE NEXT-GOAL CARD on every end screen. It plants a concrete near goal ('6 P short of Grow strength', 'Deepest 112 m - 20 m to go') at the moment motivation peaks, so closing the tab feels like pausing, not finishing. (Downwell, Hill Climb.)
3. RECORDS DRAWN IN THE WORLD. A near-miss is the strongest reason to retry, and crossing a record line is a free celebration. (Hill Climb's flag; time-trial ghosts.)
4. THE DAILY DIG. One shared 'free' shaft per UTC day, played on your own loadout; deepest wins.
   - A streak pays +3 P a day, up to 7.
   - 'Copy result' puts 'Deep Mine daily 25 Sep: 118 m (streak 3)' on the clipboard.
   - Your local best always shows. A global board appears only once the owner's Supabase migration lands, and the game degrades silently to local-only without it.
   (Spelunky daily, Wordle.)
5. ISLAND COLONIES FRUIT WHILE YOU ARE AWAY. A small, capped welcome-back: 1 P per hour per island, at most 12 h and 40 P. It rewards returning and never punishes absence.
6. THE PROGRESSIVE SHELF. A new tile on each of days 1-3 is a novelty beat and a reason to open the store. (Vampire Survivors' unlock drip.)
7. NEW JOURNEY AND COLOURS. A long tail that reuses content with one added rule per journey and a unique colour per completion (Slay the Spire Ascension). Colours are the late sink for P.

DELIBERATELY LEFT OUT, and why:
- Missions and achievements: a third goal system on top of the journey and the next-goal card; the owner's 'too complex'.
- Energy or lives timers and login calendars: they punish absence, against the owner's 'lost too much'.
- Loot boxes and random rewards.
- Perks or modifiers picked before a run: drafting in disguise.
- Mid-run resume: the premise is 'no Old'.
- Push notifications.
- Rewarded ads: a platform decision, left to the owner. There is a natural slot (double an island bonus) if they want it.
fixesRequired: Dry-for-deep soft lock (36% of runs): show Fruit now whenever water < costHere, and auto-fruit after 6 s with no successful dig and no water gain (mineFrame 37281, mineFuelCheck 22703).

Node-cap soft lock: set the mine's growth.maxNodes to 9000 in configForLevel and end the run with cause 'full' at the cap, instead of refusing every dig with 'Solid rock that way' while water remains.
The mine hint is hidden on phones by .hint{display:none} (CSS 693/1011/1059): give the mine its own #minehint element.
Taps are dead in the mine (endPointer 36675-36700): a tap on a strand digs down, a tap commits an armed enzyme or vial, and double-tap reframes.
Dev buttons are live on the plain URL (CONFIG.dev.enabled ~3597, inGameButtons 3613): off by default, on with #dev, ?dev=1 or MYCELIUM_DEV_BUTTONS.
The HUD overflows 390 px and pushes the gear (the only way to End run) off screen: two-row HUD, #gearbtn position: fixed, and an assertion that every HUD rect is inside the viewport.
'Save & exit' deletes the run and its haul (onSaveExit 35976): rename it 'Fruit & exit' and bank through mineEndRun(state,'quit').
'End run' says 'The colony was eaten' (forceFruitAbandon 33063 sets died:true): route it through mineEndRun(state,'abandon') with its own copy.
'Replay tutorial' silently restarts the run in the mine (35971): make it 'How to play', an overlay that leaves the run untouched.
Infected endings under-report depth on the end screen and in p.mineBest (mineDepthReached 21527 skips rot): pay and record the running maximum clean depth.

A dig can grow from a tip 100+ m from the pressed strand and bypass heat for an 8x discount (growDirected fall-through ~16290): in the mine, fall through only to tips within one reach of the pressed strand.
Run 1 cannot buy anything on 4 of 5 fresh saves (9 P against a 10 P floor): add the reach payout, a 10 P first rung and a 12 P first-descent floor.
Only 0-42 m pays spendable money, and diving earns half what shallow farming does: reach payout by band, with CONFIG.mine.reachPay perM [6,4,3,2].
Deep materials pile up with no sink (160 anthracite banked against a demand of 18): each material opens a rung within 2-4 runs of first finding it, with colours as the late sink.
Materials show as unlabelled coloured dots on the HUD, end screen and store: full names on the end screen and store, 3-letter tags on the HUD, and seam art tinted by material.
Ore yield silently multiplies deep materials and dominates the shelf: cut the track and refund it.
The water track is 57% of the shelf at +5 water a rung: 8 rungs of +12, 660 P in total.
Heat tolerance +150 m deletes heat from a 168 m shaft: 3 rungs of +12 m (at most +36 m).
The Mucus flask is a 0.5 s stun (1 hit of the 3 needed, stickTurns 1): mine overrides killHits 1 and excrete range 200.
Worms are 10-16 px squiggles and attach from off screen: draw attached worms at 2.5x with a pulsing ring, add edge chevrons, and make the HUD chip tap pan to them.
Worm breeding switches off once 4 chunks are explored (a global cap of 16 against 4 seeded per chunk): cap breeding by attached count (8) instead.
Clouds hunt at 5 cells/s, so avoiding them fails (trichoderma.moveSpeed 2.5): mine override 0.35 cells a tick, and clouds do not eat seams in the mine.
One enzyme dose cannot cure a real breach (radius 220 cut 118 strands to catch 6): shrink the breach (firstTouchRings 6) and make the dose cut only rot within 260 units.
Rot was not seen to creep (50 rotten strands stayed at 50 for 17 s): verify spreadDepthPerTurn 0.35 with tests/spread-probe.cjs and fix it.
No collection feedback on the map: floaters at the seam or pocket, synthesized sounds, haptics, and tapped pockets drawn drained.
Seams look the same in every band (card-game leaf litter): tint the existing art by material, and let richness scale it.
Nothing happens at the 168 m floor, and there is no goal once the depth record stalls: a core bonus per leg, plus the journey east.
The store exhausts in 56-89 runs, leaving 6,772 P unspendable: journey pacing, compasses, colours and New Journey.
The end-screen P icon renders 55-170 px (.ss-win-earned has no .ss-ri rule, CSS 1760-1767): size it 0.95em and lay the earnings out as labelled rows.
The grown SPORED wordmark clips both edges at 390 px: scale the word to the viewport width minus 32 px.
The load gate says 'CLICK' on phones (showLoading 31857): 'Tap to dig' on coarse pointers.

The store note always says '2 water a dig' (ssMineNote): quote the whole ladder and the current tolerance.
The enzyme tile promises 'a small radius' and the flask tile hides its 3-hit rule: rewrite both for the new behaviour.
The title's Upgrades button appears only when P > 0 (29889-29899): show it when any wallet is above 0 or any rung has been bought.
The HUD dig-cost chip reads a debug hook (window.__game.mine.costHere, 27194): call the mine module directly.
mineBeat and mineZoom read CONFIG instead of state.config (37244-37251, 37143-37161): read the run's config so per-leg overrides show.

__game.mine.playSeed builds the world twice (35515): start once, with the seed.

mine-check's 4 standing failures come from a probe that only digs from the deepest tip (__digTo/__aimDown 111-144): replace it with navdive's path planner, run the tolerance dive on 150 water, and remove the false PASS measured at 28 m.
CLAUDE.md's 'a colony can box itself in' is wrong (0 of 39 route-planning runs were boxed in): correct the record.
run.mjs counts a check with 0 passed and 0 failed as green: treat it as broken. CLAUDE.md already proposes this and holds it for the owner's approval.
Telemetry files a mine run with no duration, leg or cause detail: run_end gets ms and detail 'L<leg>:<cause>:e<east>'; add tutorial, island and daily events and a mine column in docs/analytics.html.
A new player's natural gesture burns the tank sideways for 0 m (naive median 28 m): tap-to-dig-down, the ghost finger, and a dead-end nudge that makes two open tips glow (runs 1-5).
cutOrDeferred: Missions (three active goals, Jetpack Joyride style): DEFERRED. They would be a third goal system on top of the journey and the next-goal card, against the owner's 'too complex'. Revisit with telemetry if D1 is weak after M8.
Achievements, a field journal, secrets in dead ends: DEFERRED. The owner said secrets come later, and a journal needs written content.
Perks or modifiers picked before Descend, and any drafting: CUT. The owner's 'too complex' and 'too much card drafting'.
Mid-run resume ('Old'): CUT. Premise: no Old, a descent is one sitting. 'Fruit & exit' banks the run instead.
The Ore yield and Water pockets store tracks: CUT. One dominates and is confusing, the other is the weakest value on the shelf. Refunded by migration.
A water-dowser compass: DEFERRED. Pockets are the fuel, and a dowser would flatten the fuel clock. Add it only if the bots show pocket-hunting dominating dead time.
Forfeiting part of the haul on rot, or rate-limiting digs while infected: CUT. Every ending is a full payout, and no human can dump a tank in 20 s anyway.
Energy or lives timers, login calendars, push notifications: CUT. They punish absence, against the owner's 'lost too much'.
Rewarded ads or a portal SDK integration: DEFERRED. It is a platform decision. The design leaves an obvious slot (double an island bonus).
A required online leaderboard: DEFERRED. It needs the owner's Supabase SQL migration. Local-first, with a silent fallback.
New art (mineral seam sprites) and a mine music track: CUT or DEFERRED. The existing leaf litter is tinted per material, every cue is synthesized, and music stays the generic playlist.
A per-band ambient drone: DEFERRED. Cheap in Web Audio, but it risks listener fatigue. Try it after M4.
Moving the mine to its own save key, and deleting the card-layer residue: DEFERRED. Neither is visible to players, and both carry migration and declaration-order risk.
The per-tick O(cells) passes inherited from the card game (about 4-6 ms): DEFERRED unless the M10 perf gate fails.
Desktop side panels beyond the journey strip, records and next goal: DEFERRED.
Heat tolerance above +36 m: CUT. It deleted heat from the shaft.
Authored leg rows beyond 8: CUT. The New Journey rules provide the long tail.

pitch:
The Deep Mine is a one-thumb maze-runner. You drag a fungal colony through a rock maze on one tank of water, and each dig costs more the deeper it starts (2/4/8/16). When the water runs out the colony spores, and every ending pays you for how far it reached. An eight-leg journey east to the Promised Land gives the digging a destination. Each leg's way east runs deeper than the last, so you dive for that band's minerals (Anthracite, Garnet, Hematite). They buy the heat tolerance, grow strength and compasses that carry you further right. Runs are short, the payout is guaranteed, and a purchase and an island are always within reach.

THE LOOP IN ONE LINE: dig until dry -> spore (1 P per 5 m reached, down or east, plus seams) -> buy one thing -> descend again and get further.
coreLoop:
A DIG (1.5-2 s). Press a strand and drag; the aim line shows the reach. On release the colony grows (grow steps x 3) segments along the corridor: about 4 m at grow 2 and about 15 m at grow 7. Water drops by the price at the strand that actually grows: 2 above the first heat line, then 4 / 8 / 16. A tap near the colony digs straight down. Anything the new tissue claims pays on the spot, with a floater and a sound: a seam (3 P, or 3 of the band's material, or 9 from a rich seam) or a water pocket (10/15/20/25 by band).

A RUN (1-3.5 min, 30-120 digs at a human 1.7 s/dig).
- It opens with a leg banner, e.g. 'LEG 3 · DRY SEAM · the island is 144 m east · the way runs near 75 m'.
- Dig down through the hill's head to the leg's trunk depth. The ground above it is walled off to the east.
- Travel east along the galleries. At each spur, decide whether to detour: for seams (P, or the band's material) or for pockets (water, since the tank is the clock).
- Flask the worms that latch on. Cut out the rot before its clock ends.
- Climb the island's head to the surface: landfall, an island bonus, and the next leg. Or the tank drops below the price at the working front: the FRUIT NOW countdown runs and the colony spores. Either way you get a full payout.

A SESSION (5-15 min, 3-6 runs). Every end screen counts up the payout by source and names one next goal, with an inline Buy, so every visit to the store (or end screen) ends in a purchase. Every session holds a 'first': a new band, a newly revealed track, a leg modifier, or an island.

THE JOURNEY. 8 legs on fixed seeds, 26-40 runs, 50-90 min (modelled, below). It ends at the Promised Land with credits.

THE LONG TAIL
- New Journeys II-VIII: fresh seeds and one cumulative rule each, 30-45 min each with the full kit.
- A Strain (strand colour) per journey, and a strains shelf to spend surplus P on.
- Per-leg best lines, and a fossil of your last attempt.
- A daily Dive on a shared seed.

WHY TODAY'S ECONOMY IS FLAT (phase-1 measurements)
- Phosphorus comes only from band-0 seams: 2 per 24 m chunk x 3 P. A descent touches about 3 chunks, so a diver's ceiling is 6 seams = 18 P.
  - Measured: run 1 pays 3-18 P against a 10 P cheapest rung; 4 of 5 first store visits bought nothing.

- Maxed runs hit the 168 m floor in 48 s with 242 water unspent.

MEASURED ROUTE COSTS (this session, eastprobe.cjs: the navigator through the fine mask, grow 2, bare prices, threats cleared)

runEnding:
WHEN A RUN ENDS. There are seven causes, all FULL PAYOUT: the haul, plus spores for reach, plus the island bonus where earned.
1. 'dry' (the soft-lock fix)
   - mineCanGrow / mineFuelCheck (22694-22709) stop asking mineCheapestCost (22686, the shallowest strand in the colony). They ask the WORKING FRONT instead: the cheapest clean strand within one resting-view height (1,407 world units, independent of the current zoom) of the focus strand (state._mineFocus, else the deepest tip).
   - When water < that price, the existing 1.6 s grace runs (a pocket already in reach still pays), then a visible 4 s countdown on the FRUIT NOW pill: 'Fruiting in 3…'.
   - Any successful dig or any water gain cancels it. At 0 the run ends 'dry'.
   - A player who pans far and digs a cheap strand keeps the run; a stuck player's run ends within 5.6 s.
   - Measured problem this replaces: 14/39 bot runs and 5/12 playtest runs sat live at 2-7 water against 4-16 a dig, for 30-60 s.
2. 'fruit' (the player's choice)
   - When water < costHere (the price chip's own number, now computed by mineDigCost directly rather than window.__game, 27194), the chip turns into a lilac pill 'FRUIT NOW · +23 P' showing what will bank.
   - One tap: mineEndRun(state, 'fruit').
   - A refused dig toasts 'Not enough water — a dig here costs 8. Fruit now to bank +23 P.'
3. 'abandon'. The mine's gear menu drops 'Replay tutorial' (it restarts the run) and 'Save & exit' (it deletes the haul). It gains 'End descent (banks everything)', which calls mineEndRun(state, 'abandon') and then presentMineEnd, instead of forceFruitAbandon's died:true (33063).
4. 'infected'. One colony clock from first contact: 30 s for the save's first infection, 20 s after (15 s on New Journey V). At 0 the whole colony turns green and fruits.
5. 'island'. Landfall (a clean strand on the island's surface span) ends the run, banks the island bonus, and advances p.mineJourney.leg.
6. 'promised'. Landfall on leg 8.
7. 'full'. The node cap is reached (mine cap 9,000, set in configForLevel instead of the shared growth.maxNodes 6000 at 2718). Today every dig at the cap says 'Solid rock' with water left.

Also:
- pagehide, or the tab hidden for more than 60 s, banks the run silently. The next title shows 'Your last descent spored +23 P'.
- Depth and east are running maxima kept in mineFrame (37281), so an infected ending no longer under-reports (107 -> 99 m measured).

threatsAndCounters:
WORMS (nematodes)
- Placed per chunk from threatBands: band 0 none, bands 1-2 one each, band 3 two. Leg modifiers raise this. They never respawn.
- They sense within 300 units (8 m), inside the resting view.
- An attached worm drinks 0.2 water/s (1 per 5 s). The fraction accumulates in mineDrainDebt, so the tank stays in whole numbers.
- Attached worms split at 5%/s. The cap becomes 6 ATTACHED per colony (config.mine.worms.maxAttached, applied in stepNematodes 17598-17760). Today's cap counts the world population (16 against 4 worms per chunk), so breeding silently switches off once 4 chunks exist.
- Unanswered from the first bite: at 20 s about 2.7 worms (0.54/s); at 40 s the cap of 6 (1.2/s). About 50 water is lost over a minute, a third of a late tank, so the threat matters.

READABLE
- Attached worms are drawn at 2.5x with a pulsing red ring and a tether to their strand (drawNematodes 40150).
- The HUD chip reads 'worm 3 · -0.6/s' and shows an edge arrow toward the nearest attached worm when it is off screen.
- Each attach plays a double tick and a 30-40-30 ms haptic. The first attach shows the tip 'A worm is drinking your water'.

COUNTER: MUCUS FLASK (carry 1/2/3 at 16 P, 60 P, 20 A)
- One tap kills EVERY worm within 160 units of any strand. In the mine branch actions.excrete.range goes 80 -> 160 and one hit kills.
- Today it is 1 hit of the 3 needed plus a 0.5 s stun; measured, it saved 0.1 water.
- Nothing respawns, so one flask ends that stretch's worm problem. Flasks 2-3 matter on The Swarm (leg 6).
- Toast: 'Mucus burst — 3 worms killed.'

MOULD (trichoderma clouds)
- From band 2: 1 per chunk; 2 on Mould Country; 2 in band 3 on leg 7+. Sight 300. Clouds creep toward the colony and eat seams.
- Contact rots the touched strands (about 20-55) and starts ONE colony clock: 30 s for the first infection of a save (it teaches), 20 s after.
- Infected strands cannot be grown from. The clock stops only when every rotten strand is gone. At 0 the whole colony fruits with a full payout.
- The real cost is the rest of your tank: a human digs about 12 times in 20 s.

READABLE
- The rot fades green on the strands.
- The HUD timer pill turns red under 10 s, with a heartbeat: 60 Hz thumps at 1 Hz, rising to 2 Hz under 5 s.
- Arming the enzyme brightens the rotten component.
- The first cloud on screen shows the tip 'Mould: touching it starts a 30 s rot clock'.
- The sight ring stays the owner's plain flat green (120,155,45 @0.15, no outline).

COUNTER: CUTTING ENZYME (carry 1/2/3 at 30 P, 80 P, 20 G)
- Arm it, then TAP or drag on the rot. This fixes the dead tap path at 36700.
- mineUseAmputate (22563) removes the whole connected rotten component: a flood over infected strands through parent/child links and within one segment, via _removeNodes (16943). It also takes a one-segment clean margin.
- One dose cures one breach, whatever its size. Today one 220-unit disc left 12 of 55 rotten, and 3 doses cost 32% of the colony.
- Two separate contacts still need two doses, so 'find all of it' stays the decision.

HEAT (priced, never enforced)
- 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 water a dig past lines at 42 / 84 / 126 m.
- Priced at the strand that actually grows. growDirected's fall-through (~16290) is limited to tips within one grow reach of the pressed strand. That closes the measured 8x bypass: 137-142 m growth charged 2.
- Heat tolerance moves the first line down 21 m per rung (42 -> 168 at VI, the capstone for the Promised Land).
- Readable: the chip always quotes the price and turns orange when hot. Band beats say it: '84 m · GARNET · digs cost 8'. The heat tile names the leg it unlocks: 'Leg 3's way east is at 75 m: Heat II keeps digs at 2.'

ROCK-THROUGH: ACID VIAL (carry 1/2/3 at 45 P, 25 A, 20 H; revealed on leg 3)
- The owner sanctioned this consumable.
- Arm it, then drag. The dig's path may pass through up to 120 units (3.3 cells) of rock, and it must end in open ground. Otherwise the dig is refused and the vial and water are kept: a miss costs nothing.
- The rock stays a wall for everything else. The collision mask is untouched and the tunnel strand is drawn amber.
- Uses:
  - a stranded seam behind a boulder (the generator already leaves 'bait');
  - one 3-column seam wall, to shortcut a chunk on the crust;
  - a wrong-way corridor.
- Scarce, bought, restocked each descent.

| rot heartbeat | 60 Hz, 90 ms, 1 Hz rising to 2 Hz under 5 s |
| Fruit-now countdown start | descending G-E-C |
| fruit | C-E-G arpeggio, 300 ms |
| landfall | C-E-G-C' with a shimmer |
| buy | two-note chime, rising |
| new record | 2 kHz bell, 1.5 s |

| event | pattern |
|---|---|
| seam | 12 ms |
| pocket | 20 ms |
| worm attach | 30-40-30 |
